scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --parallel --filter @waypoint/web --filter @waypoint/api run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --parallel run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run test
